plugins.name: context-rotation
plugins.description: Measures how full a Claude Code session's context is, warns before it degrades, and carries a checked handover into a fresh session after /clear.

plugins.name: slop-lint
plugins.description: Deterministic linter for AI tics in Dutch prose: em-dashes, buzzwords, comma chains and rhetorical frames. Lints every text file Claude writes and hands the findings back so Claude fixes them.

plugins.name: context-meter
plugins.description: One line above the prompt that shows how full the context is, in the bands of the context-rotation guard: green, yellow and red.

plugins.name: php-lek-check
plugins.description: Dutch check for website owners on PHP2Shell (CVE-2026-109618, CVE-2026-109619): reads the PHP signals your own site shows and writes a message for your host. Does not establish whether a site is vulnerable.

plugins.name: reverse-engineer
plugins.description: Dutch skill that helps you build what a LinkedIn post promises or asks for: comment gates and search requests. Chooses the form first (paste prompt, skill, plugin, proof of concept, site or just buy it), names the hard part, the time and what self-build does not do. Comes with a paste prompt for ChatGPT and Claude in the browser.

plugins.name: onder-de-motorkap
plugins.description: Dutch skill that explains in plain language what each part of an AI build does and why: a prompt, skill, plugin, workflow, small tool, site or someone else's tool. Labels every statement as seen, inferred or unknown. Comes with a paste prompt for ChatGPT and Claude in the browser.
